questions.prompt: The Elgin Marbles were removed from which building?
questions.fact: Their ownership has been formally disputed since Greek independence in the 1830s and remains unresolved.

questions.prompt: What is the process by which a solid becomes a gas directly?
questions.fact: Dry ice does it at ordinary pressure, which is why it produces fog rather than a puddle.

questions.prompt: How many pins are set at the start of a tenpin bowling frame?
questions.fact: The game exists because an earlier nine-pin version was banned in parts of America over gambling.

questions.prompt: Which video game series is set in the Mushroom Kingdom?
questions.fact: Its designer has said the pipes came from watching workers install plumbing outside his office.

questions.prompt: Which is the smallest country in mainland Africa by area?
questions.fact: Its shape follows a river, and one story holds the borders were fixed by how far a gunboat could fire from midstream.

questions.prompt: Which poem features the Lady of Shalott?
questions.fact: It became a favourite subject of Pre-Raphaelite painters, who returned to the same scene repeatedly.

questions.prompt: Which technology allows a single machine to run multiple isolated operating systems?
questions.fact: Containers do something similar with far less overhead by sharing one kernel rather than emulating hardware.
